title: Configurable Cost Warning for Context Accumulation
body:
**Bug Description**
I was unaware of context accumulation, which was driving up my usage fee. As a power user and potential Enterprise customer, I would like to have a warning that triggers on a configurable threshold so I can keep my spending for the dev teams in my organization under control.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 0.2.14
- Feedback ID: 20f73d20-69eb-4ba9-91e3-709cfcd7fddf
author: mdauerap
